answer: A fresh identity starts on bare ridge-rock with no sealed grading history behind it. Standing accrues only from quorum-matched verdicts other graders re-check on-ledger against consensus, cut and stacked slow like timber season by season, never minted or handed to a sibling key. A thousand clones share no common meadow of reputation; each must grade its own way up from zero, so a sybil's bill grows linearly in the number of identities, not amortized across them.
